name: Hinata Sakura
source:
[url=/c74484]Shirou[/url]'s adoptive mother and she loves him as her own child. After her husband died in an accident a few years ago, she has been doing her best to raise the 3 children. Because she wants all of them to be able to enter university, she often works overtime and recently her family is worried about her health because of that. She's recently been missing the skinship she had with Shirou when he was little.

[url=/c17979]Sawako[/url]'s sudden appearance was really surprising for her and she feels scared that Sawako is going to steal Shirou away. Because of that she starts to increase the amount of skinship to the point of insisting of entering the bath together.
translation:
[url=/c74484]Shirou[/url]'s adoptive mother and she loves him as her own child. After her husband died in an accident a few years ago, she has been doing her best to raise the 3 children. Because she wants all of them to be able to enter university, she often works overtime and recently her family is worried about her health because of that. She's recently been missing the skinship she had with Shirou when he was little.

[url=/c17979]Sawako[/url]'s sudden appearance was really surprising for her and she feels scared that Sawako is going to steal Shirou away. Because of that she starts to increase the amount of skinship to the point of insisting of entering the bath together.
